name: Faroe Islands: Løgtingslógir, Kunngerðir and Løgtingslógarkunngerðir in force (Lógasavnið, logir.fo)
label: Faroe Islands
record_note: logir.fo publishes only the current consolidated text of each act, so each act has one version here: the text as retrieved on 2026-10-29. There is no line-by-line history before that day. The site's amendment notes are kept in each act's notes.md and parsed into data/amendments.csv (9801 rows naming 1409 amending acts).

dates.commit: the retrieval day (logir.fo gives no consolidation date); Date-source: retrieved
dates.time: 12:00 Atlantic/Faroe (UTC+0; UTC+1 with summer time, EU rule, from 1981)
dates.before_1970: not needed: every commit is dated by the retrieval day

scope.when_absent: not extracted for the Faroe Islands; each amending act's in-force clause, where the site quotes it, is in data/amendments.csv (in_force_clause)

default_reach.meaning: an act applies from its entry into force and does not reach completed facts unless it says so; criminal law is not applied retroactively to the accused's detriment
default_reach.authority: general principle of Danish-Faroese law; for criminal law Revsilógin (Løgtingslógarkunngerð nr. 8/2024, logtingslogarkunngerd/2024/8) § 1 (no punishment without law) and § 3 (a change after the act: the new law, but never harsher than the old)
